laws.name: preview-deadline-call-sites-resolve-to-table
laws.description: Every site that fires a preview-start deadline resolves its user-visible wording from PREVIEW_DEADLINE_MESSAGE_KEYS by asking for a KEY; no call site spells a deadline sentence, and the guard is either constructed and consulted or absent.

laws.name: probe-concurrent-platforms-printout-is-measured
laws.description: The concurrent-platforms check is real and honest: probe.py declares it, the offline run samples it, the printed doc equals what the trusted probe_core says about the SAME samples, every platform arm is recorded, and three unreachable arms are reported as not_measured - never as a pass with empty percentiles.

laws.name: preview-ceiling-order-first-output-under-stage-total
laws.description: For every preview-retry stage the FIRST-OUTPUT ceiling is at or under that stage's TOTAL ceiling: both ceiling tables in src/previewRetry.ts are declared exactly once, carry the same stage keys, hold literal positive millisecond values, and are read by previewDeadlineFire. A first-output ceiling above its total would fire the total first, collapsing the silence/timeout distinction into one deadline while still showing an error and still passing every healthy probe.
